pages.title: Storage Logistics
pages.text: The Storage Actuator behaves much like a big chest or shulker box.$(br) That means, hoppers and pipes can insert and extract items.$(br)

pages.title: Performance
pages.text: Due to the potentially huge amount of items in the storage system,$(br) it is good to consider some performance aspects, otherwise your$(br) system might slow down your game or even a server you are playing on.$(br)

pages.title: Extracting Items
pages.text: Extracting items can lead to performance issues, especially when pipes with Item Filters$(br) are used, because then the entire huge storage is searched for these items one by one.$(br2) $(br) To *massively* improve $()

pages.title: Extracting Items
pages.text: performance, use Transporter Spirits to extract from the$(br) Storage Actuator or Stable Wormhole. Even if the Spirit deposits into a chest$(br) right next to the storage system, and a pipe extracts from that chest, the$()

pages.title: Extracting Items
pages.text: $(br) performance is $(bold)much$() better than if a pipe extracts directly.$(br)

pages.title: Inserting Items
pages.text: When inserting items, you do not need to do anything, the Storage Actuator will$(br) maximize performance automatically for you. It is safe to insert high amounts$(br) of items at high frequencies without negative impact on game $()
